rejection_findings.finding: The private-appeals clause must be limited to third-stage private appeals as required by claim_laws_0472.

revisions.title: Different disputes, different procedures
revisions.body: The proposed courts differentiate procedure by kind of case. At the third stage of private appeals, a common court is formed with judges selected by the offices; public indictments begin and end with the people while three high offices examine; tribal courts use jurors chosen by lot for private cases. The point is differentiated procedure.
